message: SQL query built by concatenating user-controlled input
ruleName: SQL query built by concatenating user-controlled input
ruleDescription: Anyone who controls customerID can append arbitrary SQL — reading other customers' orders or altering data. This path is reachable from the public guest-checkout API without authentication.

tokens.text: // TODO: move to sqlc once split tender lands

message: Live Stripe secret key hard-coded in configuration class
ruleName: Live Stripe secret key hard-coded in configuration class
ruleDescription: The key grants full access to the Stripe account — charges, refunds and customer data. It is already in git history, so removing the line is not enough.

message: JWT decoded without verifying its signature
ruleName: JWT decoded without verifying its signature
ruleDescription: Any client can forge a token with arbitrary sub and scopes and it will be accepted. Introduced by "auth: accept tokens from legacy issuer".

message: Campaign HTML rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitizing
ruleName: Campaign HTML rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitizing
ruleDescription: A CMS user (or anyone who compromises one) can inject script that runs on the checkout page with access to card-entry iframes and session cookies.

message: yaml.load with the full Loader allows arbitrary object construction
ruleName: yaml.load with the full Loader allows arbitrary object construction
ruleDescription: A crafted YAML file can execute code in the scoring service, which has read access to transaction history.

message: unwrap() on a fallible lookup in the posting path can panic the worker
ruleName: unwrap() on a fallible lookup in the posting path can panic the worker
ruleDescription: A panic aborts the Tokio worker and drops every in-flight posting on it. The function already returns Result, so the error can be propagated.

message: Promise from refreshToken() is neither awaited nor handled
ruleName: Promise from refreshToken() is neither awaited nor handled
ruleDescription: Callers retry with an expired token and see a burst of 401s; in Node this also crashes the process under --unhandled-rejections=strict.

message: Error returned by json.Encoder.Encode is ignored
ruleName: Error returned by json.Encoder.Encode is ignored
ruleDescription: Silent failures here leave clients with truncated JSON and no server-side log line to correlate.
The split-tender change already had to fix the same rounding bug in two of the four copies.

message: Broad except Exception hides scoring failures and returns 0.0
ruleName: Broad except Exception hides scoring failures and returns 0.0
ruleDescription: Any feature or model error silently approves the transaction, which is the worst possible fallback for a fraud check.
Tax rules change quarterly; every change here has needed a hotfix in the past year.

message: unsafe block without a // SAFETY: comment
ruleName: unsafe block without a // SAFETY: comment
ruleDescription: Tuple layout is unspecified in Rust; a compiler upgrade can silently corrupt every amount built this way.
